headline: Congress named a post office building in Reidsville, Georgia, after former state senator Jack Hill.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 111 James Street in Reidsville, Georgia, as the Senator Jack Hill Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, when it was signed.
